description: This is a PHP test class named DataGroupDaoTest that contains unit tests for the DataGroupDao class, which manages data group permissions and entities within the OrangeHRM system. The file sets up test data, interacts with the DataGroupDao, and verifies its methods behave as expected.

classes.name: DataGroupDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit-based test class validating the functionality of DataGroupDao methods related to data groups and permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by loading fixture data, truncating relevant tables, and instantiating the DataGroupDao object.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Verifies that the getDataGroupPermission method correctly retrieves permissions and that the permission canRead() returns the expected value.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Checks that the getDataGroups method returns the expected number of data groups.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupsNoneDefined
methods.description: Ensures that when the ohrm_data_group table is emptied, getDataGroups returns an empty list.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests retrieving specific DataGroup entities by their identifiers and verifies their properties.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupInvalid
methods.description: Checks that requesting a non-existent data group returns null.
